```yaml
name: E2E Tests

on:
  push:
    branches: [ main, master ]
  pull_request:
    branches: [ main, master ]

jobs:
  e2e:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest

    steps:
      - name: Checkout repository
        uses: actions/checkout@v4

      - name: Set up Go
        uses: actions/setup-go@v5
        with:
          go-version: 'stable'

      - name: Set up Rust
        uses: actions/setup-rust@v1
        with:
          rust-version: stable

      - name: Set up Node.js
        uses: actions/setup-node@v4
        with:
          node-version: '20'

      - name: Install Rust dependencies
        run: cargo build --release

      - name: Build Tavern frontend
        run: |
          cd frontend
          npm install
          npm run build

      - name: Start Tavern server
        run: |
          cargo run --bin tavern-server &
          sleep 5

      - name: Retrieve server public key
        id: get-key
        run: |
          PUBLIC_KEY=$(curl -s http://localhost:8080/api/public-key)
          echo "public_key=$PUBLIC_KEY" >> $GITHUB_OUTPUT

      - name: Build Imixv2 agent
        run: cargo build --release --bin imixv2-agent

      - name: Start Imixv2 agent
        run: |
          ./target/release/imixv2-agent --key ${{ steps.get-key.outputs.public_key }} &
          sleep 5

      - name: Install Playwright dependencies
        run: |
          cd tests/e2e
          npm install
          npx playwright install --with-deps

      - name: Run Playwright E2E tests
        run: |
          cd tests/e2e
          npx playwright test

      - name: Cleanup processes
        if: always()
        run: |
          pkill -f tavern-server || true
          pkill -f imixv2-agent || true
```
